Recommendations

Verify PX4 is armed and rocket_mpc module is running — fin commands are near-zero
Range error is -35.2% — tune MPC guidance gains or verify thrust curve
High in-flight AoA — consider lowering qp_solver_cond_N further or reducing N_horizon
Pitch oscillation in terminal phase — check damping gains and actuator bandwidth
Servo tracking MAE=4.23° exceeds 1.5° limit — check fin mechanical play, servo_auto_zero calibration, CAN bus speed
⚠ SERVO DELAY: Increase RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY to ~0.134s (estimated from tracking P95=16.5° + 40ms overhead). This gives lookahead_stage=7. For precise value: measure cmd→can lag on bench.
